The combined company is expected to have an equity market capitalization of ~$5B, with 58% of pro forma net operating income coming from Sunbelt markets, 27% from the Midwest, and 15% from the Mountain West.
The deal is expected to be ~5% accretive to IRT’s 2027 core funds from operations per share, supported by about $24M in annualized synergies.
The merger is expected to close in Q4 2026. The company will keep the Independence Realty Trust name and continue trading under the IRT ticker on the NYSE.
CSR stock price traded marginally higher on Wednesday pre-market hours.
